(middle form) I fasten with a leather strap (τροπῷ [with a leather strap]) to the thole-pin.

The Antiatticist in Bekker's Anecdota p. 114, 25 noted the expression τροποῦσθαι κώπην [to fasten the oar] from Eubulus. Hesychius: τροπώσασθαι [to fasten]: to bind the oar to the thole-pin with the leather strap. τροπώσασθαι ναῦν [to fasten the ship] in Pollux 1, 87.
and the sailor fastened the oar around the well-rowed thole-pin.
